findings: Requested check 'Linux and native success conjunction' is not evidenced in either file. bootstrap_controller.rs::Controller::finish() returns success/exit status derived solely from the native child process (WaitForSingleObject + child.wait()), with no reference to the Linux subject's outcome. cross_os_reset.rs::Subject::finish() unconditionally copies the enumerated mailbox files (including seal.json) to the evidence directory without inspecting seal.json's contents or otherwise asserting Linux-side success. Neither file cross-references the other's success/failure state, so the conjunction of Linux and native success cannot be confirmed from this evidence; if it exists it must live in code not provided here.
